readerCopy.body: Control can become compulsive when one more piece of information keeps promising the certainty an old fear has never been able to keep. When Pluto squares Chiron, power and sensitivity create friction, making rejection, dependence, trust, or the possibility of being overruled turn an unknown into repeated checking. If one more check keeps promising that you will finally feel certain, you may notice how quickly each answer creates another thing to verify. Facts are useful for decisions; they cannot guarantee that surprise or vulnerability will never return.
